definitions.gloss: to hand over, to deliver, to turn over
definitions.explanation: To formally transfer possession of something (a building, property, goods) to another party. Often used in business and legal contexts for the completion of a transaction.

definitions.gloss: to extradite, to hand over (a person)
definitions.explanation: To turn over a person, especially a criminal suspect, to another authority or country. Used in law enforcement and international legal contexts.

notes:
USAGE:
Godan verb conjugating as {引|ひ}き{渡|わた}す・{引|ひ}き{渡|わた}して. The noun form ⟦{引|ひ}き{渡|わた}し→引き渡し：30090_hikiwatashi⟧ (handover, delivery, extradition) is extremely common. In real estate, ⟦{引|ひ}き{渡|わた}し→引き渡し：30090_hikiwatashi⟧ refers to the handover of keys and possession after a sale or lease. In international law, ⟦{引|ひ}き{渡|わた}し→引き渡し：30090_hikiwatashi⟧⟦{条約|じょうやく}→条約：04912_jouyaku⟧ is an extradition treaty.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{渡|わた}し→引き渡し：30090_hikiwatashi⟧{日|び}: handover date
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{渡|わた}し→引き渡し：30090_hikiwatashi⟧⟦{条約|じょうやく}→条約：04912_jouyaku⟧: extradition treaty
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{引|ひ}き{渡|わた}す: hand over to ~
- ⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{渡|わた}し→引き渡し：30090_hikiwatashi⟧: property handover
